classification.difficultyReason: Derives proportional side pairs from equal subdivisions, proves SAS similarity and finds three lengths.

content.prompt: Prove that triangles $ABC$, $ADE$, $AFG$, and $AHI$ are similar and find $x$, $y$ and $z$.

spec.description: Four nested triangles; each sloping side has four equal subdivisions. Left-side subdivisions have single ticks and right-side subdivisions double ticks. No parallel marks are supplied. Ordinary strokes are black.
spec.mathematics: AB=BD=DF=FH; AC=CE=EG=GI; BC=z, DE=y, FG=x, HI=32.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown lengths remain x, y and z.

answer.short:
$\triangle ABC\sim\triangle ADE\sim\triangle AFG\sim\triangle AHI$ (SAS). $x=24$, $y=16$, $z=8$.

The equal subdivisions give scale factors $1:2:3:4$ from the common vertex.
answer.worked:
The marked equal subdivisions give

$$\frac{AB}{AH}=\frac{AC}{AI}=\frac14,\qquad \frac{AD}{AH}=\frac{AE}{AI}=\frac12,\qquad \frac{AF}{AH}=\frac{AG}{AI}=\frac34.$$

The included angle at $A$ is common to all four triangles. Therefore $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle ADE\sim\triangle AFG\sim\triangle AHI$ (SAS).

Using matching sides:

$$\begin{align*}x&=\frac34\times32\\x&=24\\y&=\frac12\times32\\y&=16\\z&=\frac14\times32\\z&=8\end{align*}$$
